integrity: All results presented are mathematical statements proved in the accompanying text; finite checks are supporting evidence and not infinite proofs. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Split dual numbers for finite counts; unaugmented entry-equation schemes for generic reducedness. No claim of global reducedness or of conjugacy-class counts over dual numbers. Earlier sources already contain the differential operator and one-block subcase; historical priority is provisional.
title: Power-zero matrix schemes: exact dual-number fibers and a generic-reducedness divisibility criterion
